llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Notion-backed emotional memory and journaling tool with sensitive persistence, but its behavior is coherent with that purpose and bounded by explicit user configuration.

dimensions.detail: The skill requires Notion credentials and reads/writes the configured agent workspace memory area, but scripts use explicit database IDs, workspace paths, limits, dry-run modes, receipts, and local state files rather than broad filesystem or hidden network access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package has no install scripts or third-party npm dependencies; setup is manual and depends on Node plus a separately installed Notion automation skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions shape a persona/continuity workflow and mention subagent delegation, but they keep writes in the main agent, limit delegation to read-only analysis, and explicitly preserve current user instructions over stored profile defaults.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It persists data to Notion and local JSON/JSONL files, including ambient recall state and retry receipts; that persistence is central to the skill, documented, and bounded, though users should understand the privacy implications before enabling cron or ambient recall.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill stores and recalls emotional events, state snapshots, journals, vents, and continuity checks; this is sensitive but matches the stated purpose and is repeatedly disclosed in SKILL.md and README.md.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intentionally want this agent to maintain emotional memory and journals in your Notion workspace. Review the Notion databases, cron cadence, workspace path, ambient recall setting, and credential injection method; keep vents and personal state data out of shared Notion spaces unless that is deliberate.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: Local receipts, lockfiles, mirrors, Notion schema checks, and API calls are real, but they are disclosed, scoped to configured Notion databases/workspace paths, and proportionate to durable memory and recall.
[AE1] unexpected: The referenced files flagged as partially inspected are present in the artifact and were inspected; I found no hidden unavailable payload or analysis-evasion behavior in those references.
[PE3] unexpected: The .env-related evidence is from a test harness that sanitizes test environment variables; it does not read credential files or hardcode secret paths in production code.
[RA1] unexpected: The cited 'Update skill' text is an error hint for an incompatible dependency, not code that modifies the skill or its configuration at runtime.
[MP3] expected: The skill intentionally manages memory/state artifacts, but the cited delete operation only removes an internal transient load-error field before saving ambient recall state.
